description: Fetch one issue by website_id + issue number, including its full description, recommendation, affected pages, occurrence detail from the latest report (which page/image/URL, snippets), and comment thread. The issue carries `provenance` as in list_issues ("fresh": re-checked this audit; "carried": not re-crawled, so `last_seen_at` is when it was last actually observed and a re-crawl should confirm it before you edit anything; "unrendered": never rendered, no `last_seen_at`; both keys absent when none was recorded). `occurrence_count` is the true total; the listed occurrences are a sample when `occurrences_truncated` is true, and on a capped report `full_detail` says where every occurrence is. Use comment_on_issue to add analysis or a fix note to the thread.

occurrence_limit.description: Max occurrences to include (default 20); see occurrence_count/truncated.

website_id.description: Website id the issue belongs to.

name: get_issue
title: Get issue detail
